description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller class 'CustomerOrdersController' responsible for handling customer order-related requests in an e-commerce web application. It includes methods for listing customer orders and viewing order details, interacting with services and facades to retrieve order data, customer info, and downloads, and renders corresponding views.

classes.name: CustomerOrdersController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller handling customer order views, including listing orders and viewing order details. It manages interactions with order, customer, and download services, and renders appropriate templates.

methods.name: listOrders
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests to list the current customer's orders with pagination. Retrieves customer data, fetches order list via a facade, and prepares model attributes for rendering the orders view.

methods.name: orderDetails
methods.description: Handles requests to view details of a specific order by order ID. Checks customer authorization, retrieves order data and associated downloads, populates model attributes, and renders the order detail view.
